rawConfiguration.text:
## Document parser load test (`deployment.environment = loadtest`)
**Service:** `Python 3.11`, `FastAPI` + `Gunicorn/Uvicorn` (`ENV_TYPE=dev` during load). **Pipeline:** parser + `otel-collector-loadtest` sidecar on `loadnet` scrape `/api/v1/metrics`, export OTLP to EU as `loadtest`.
Run: `make load-test WITH_OBSERVABILITY=1 VUS=50 DURATION=2m` from `services/document-parser`. k6 pass/fail (p95<1500ms, p99<3000ms, 0 errors) stays in k6 output; this board shows server-side latency/saturation and host infra for the same window. Compare `Server latency` here against k6 `http_req_duration` to spot client-vs-server gaps.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `uploads/min` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server' AND http.route = '/api/v1/extract'
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server' AND http.route = '/api/v1/extract'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 99) AS `p99 ms` WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server' AND http.route = '/api/v1/extract'

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server' AND http.route = '/api/v1/extract' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND name = 'extraction' FACET cases(WHERE `mime.type` LIKE '%pdf%' AS 'pdf', WHERE `mime.type` LIKE '%officedocument%' AS 'docx', WHERE `mime.type` LIKE '%plain%' AS 'txt') TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Metric SELECT average(extraction_pool_queue_depth) AS `queue depth`, average(extraction_pool_active_threads) AS `busy workers`, average(extraction_pool_max_workers) AS `max workers`, average(in_flight_requests) AS `in-flight` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND span.kind = 'server' FACET `http.status_code` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Metric SELECT average(`system.cpu.load_average.1m`) AS `cpu load 1m` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT average(`system.memory.usage`) AS bytes WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET state TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 8

FROM Metric SELECT sum(otelcol_exporter_sent_spans) AS sent, sum(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans) AS failed WHERE service.name = 'otelcol-contrib' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Log volume by level (load, click legend to isolate)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET `severity.text` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Span SELECT max(duration.ms) AS `max ms`, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms`, count(*) WHERE service.name = 'document-parser' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND name = 'extraction' FACET cases(WHERE `mime.type` LIKE '%pdf%' AS 'pdf', WHERE `mime.type` LIKE '%officedocument%' AS 'docx', WHERE `mime.type` LIKE '%plain%' AS 'txt') LIMIT 20
FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS spans FACET service.name, service.version WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service.name IN ('document-parser', 'otel-collector') LIMIT 20
